Brand exploration · shortlist

Socratic Trade — the keepers, in one place

Everything saved so far: four concepts kept from this session's board, the three picks from the earlier session (Examined Trade, Dialectic, Stoa), and the four Adobe Firefly comps — now with proper light and dark versions (backgrounds removed so they sit on any ground).

Kept from this session

Inscription, Delta, Argument, and Monogram, each shown on light and dark grounds.

B

Inscription

Wide-tracked serif capitals with a hairline rule — the classical read.

E

Delta

Stacked caps; the A of TRADE is a green delta — change, the thing being traded.

H

Argument

A dialogue bubble holding a rising line — argues about markets, then acts.

I

Monogram — S.T

Serif S.T with the green period; crops perfectly into a square avatar.

Kept from the earlier session

The three marks picked on the other board: The Examined Trade, Dialectic (v2 tails), and The Stoa. Colors adapted to the shared palette so they theme like everything else.

O

The Examined Trade

A magnifying glass over two candles — "the unexamined trade is not worth placing." Keeps both market colors under scrutiny.

P

Dialectic

Question and answer: an outlined bubble asks, a filled green bubble answers with a rising line. The Socratic method in two shapes.

Q

The Stoa

The philosopher's porch whose middle column is a green candlestick — Greek architecture carrying a market core.

The Firefly comps — light & dark versions

Your four Adobe Firefly images, cleaned up for use on both grounds: backgrounds (white page, baked-in checkerboard) removed so the artwork floats on light or dark. Full-resolution transparent PNGs are saved alongside this page.

F1

Owl badge (v1)

Candle letterforms over the globe disc, owl and scroll on top. White page background removed.

F2

Owl badge (v2)

Same composition, softer disc; the drop shadow was removed along with the background so it sits clean on dark.

F3

Candle letters

The pure letters-of-candlesticks type treatment. The baked-in transparency checkerboard was removed — including inside the closed letters — so this now has real transparency.

F4

Chart scene

The 3D terminal rendering is dark-native — it's a full scene rather than a logo with removable background, so it's kept as a single hero-style image. Best used as artwork (landing hero, social banner), not a mark.

F5

Candle letters, upright — vector remake

The Firefly letters-of-candlesticks idea rebuilt from scratch as a real vector: every letter of SOCRATIC TRADE filled with red and green candles (bodies + wicks), stood perfectly vertical instead of tilted. Scales cleanly to any size; SVG source in the repo.

F6

The Morph — animated

One set of 110 candlesticks spells SOCRATIC for 3 seconds, then each candle drifts — wandering, stretching, shrinking — for 6 seconds until the same candles spell TRADE, holds 3 seconds, and morphs back. 18-second loop, pure SVG + CSS (no JavaScript), honors reduced-motion preferences.

F7

Console intro — chart becomes the logo

Page-open moment for the console: an unnamed asset's candlestick chart holds for 2 seconds, then all 182 candles fly up to the top-left — keeping their colors — and settle as the SOCRATIC TRADE wordmark where the header logo lives. The chart is generated from the logo: each candle's up/down direction matches its landing color. One-shot SVG + CSS, ~6 seconds; reduced-motion users see the settled logo immediately. Reload the page to replay.

Sources: concepts B/E/H/I from this session's fourteen-direction board; O/P/Q from the earlier session's twelve-concept board (owner's picks); F1–F4 generated in Adobe Firefly by the owner, backgrounds removed here. Full-res transparent PNGs: docs/branding/firefly/ in the repo.
